issue: QA process: on case-insensitive APFS, writing SUMMARY.json after raw summary.json (same name, different case) replaced the raw CLI envelope with QA summary content (file keeps the lowercase name)
impact: raw envelopes not kept verbatim; every summary embeds the envelope data/meta/others_since_last fields (and request ids, rc, PDU bytes); journal + fixture logs remain independent primary evidence
mitigation: from 08:2xZ: raw CLI outputs named raw-<step>.json, QA summaries sum-<step>.json (prefix-distinct, never case-only); affected files keep their overwritten provenance and are NOT reconstructed as raw (ROOT)
